title: BlockFi Interest Account product launches
description: BlockFi offered interest-bearing crypto accounts that paid yield on deposited digital assets.
notes: Launch month is based on public product history and should be refined if exact first availability documentation is added.

title: SEC announces BlockFi Interest Account settlement
description: The SEC announced charges and a settlement concerning BlockFi Lending LLC's retail crypto lending product, the BlockFi Interest Account.
notes: Core regulatory event for BIA classification.

title: BlockFi pauses client withdrawals
description: BlockFi paused withdrawals amid uncertainty after the FTX collapse and related market contagion.
notes: Date tracks BlockFi's public pause period before the Chapter 11 filing.

title: BlockFi files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
description: BlockFi and affiliated entities filed voluntary Chapter 11 cases in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the District of New Jersey.
notes: Primary bankruptcy event for the BlockFi platform.

title: BlockFi announces emergence from bankruptcy
description: BlockFi announced it had emerged from bankruptcy and would continue wind-down and client recovery activities under its plan.
notes: Post-confirmation wind-down event rather than a return to normal platform operations.

title: BlockFi begins estate distributions
description: BlockFi began distributions to customers with allowed claims through its post-bankruptcy wind-down process.
notes: The distribution process occurred in waves and differed by account type, jurisdiction, and completed verification requirements.

title: Plan administrator announces 100% recovery on allowed claims
description: After monetizing BlockFi's FTX-related claims, the plan administrator announced capacity for a near-term final distribution equal to 100% of allowed customer and general unsecured creditor claims in petition-date dollar terms.
notes: This was a recovery and distribution announcement, not proof that every creditor had already received payment. It refers to allowed dollarized bankruptcy claims, not restoration of the original quantity or later market value of deposited crypto assets.
